title: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp
claim: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
why_good: A giant free-coding-education nonprofit — hugely impactful, but a donation-funded community, not a startup.
value: Explicitly non-commercial; there's no founder opportunity in cloning it.
risk: Established nonprofit with a massive brand; a signal, not a buildable business.

zh.claim: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp —— 开源课程与代码库,免费学数学、编程与计算机科学。
zh.why_good: 一个巨大的免费编程教育非营利组织——影响力极大,但它是靠捐赠的社区,不是创业。
zh.value: 明确非商业;复制它没有创始人机会。
zh.risk: 成熟的非营利、品牌巨大;是信号,不是可搭建的生意。
